name: Kamakhya Temple
description: A hilltop pilgrimage site overlooking the Brahmaputra and one of Assam’s most important temples.
demo_review: Beautiful hilltop views. Go early and confirm the queue before you set off.

name: Kaziranga National Park
description: UNESCO-listed floodplain grasslands known for the Indian one-horned rhinoceros.
demo_review: An unforgettable landscape. Book official safari slots ahead, especially in season.

name: Umiam Lake
description: A wide reservoir framed by forested hills on the road between Guwahati and Shillong.
demo_review: Lovely stop on the Shillong drive. The lake looks best in clear weather.

name: Double Decker Living Root Bridge
description: A remarkable living bridge in Nongriat, reached by a long stairway descent and climb.
photo_query: Double Decker Living Root Bridge Nongriat
demo_review: Start early and carry water for the steps. The walk is a big part of the experience.

name: Maniharan Tunnel
description: A historic pilgrimage site near Silchar, set beside the Barak River valley.
demo_review: A peaceful visit. Check local transport timings before planning a return trip.

name: Loktak Lake
description: Manipur’s vast freshwater lake, famous for floating vegetation islands called phumdis.
demo_review: The floating islands are extraordinary. Agree the boat price and duration before boarding.

name: Kangla Fort
description: The historic seat of the former kingdom of Manipur in the heart of Imphal.
demo_review: Plan a few hours for the grounds and museum; check current entry information locally.

name: Dzükou Valley
description: High green meadows on the Nagaland–Manipur border, known for seasonal wildflowers.
demo_review: Bring layers and check trail conditions with local guides before starting.

name: Kisama Heritage Village
description: A heritage village showcasing Naga architecture and traditions near Kohima.
demo_review: The festival season is lively. Confirm dates and transport before you go.

name: Ita Fort
description: An ancient brick fort and a quiet historic landmark in the Arunachal capital.
demo_review: A short heritage stop in town; pair it with another nearby visit.

name: Ganga Lake (Gekar Sinyi)
description: A forest-fringed lake on the edge of Itanagar, popular for a calm nature break.
demo_review: Quiet and green. Check local road and entry conditions after heavy rain.

name: Assam Engineering College
description: A landmark campus in Jalukbari, close to the Guwahati–Shillong road.
demo_review: The Jalukbari campus is easy to reach. Confirm your gate and fare before riding.
